purpose: Teach: 臨時/外側/民生/自前/和風/出会える/全般/丁度

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、臨時、絶対、店休日、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、知ってたわよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious — I absolutely knew it was a closed day.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Light teasing in the voice. Leans into the certainty with a smile underneath. Playful confidence without any edge.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、外側、絶対、看板、絶対、塗り替えたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And I'm telling you, she really did repaint that shop sign.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact agreement. Eyes steady, small nod in the voice. Practical tone that says 'here's what happened.' No performance, just fact delivered with quiet pride.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、民生、絶対、向け、絶対、お弁当、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、応援してるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm absolutely serious — she's supporting that bento business for everyday customers.
lines.style: Genuine warmth with conviction underneath. Slight lean forward in the voice. The kind of enthusiasm that comes from actually believing in what you're saying, not performing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、自前、絶対、の野菜、絶対、お店で、絶対、提供してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she's using her own vegetables at the shop, really providing quality.
lines.style: Pride speaking softly. Each phrase gets its own small weight. Not boasting — observing something real with admiration. The voice carries quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、和風、絶対、メニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お気に入りよ
lines.en: Aoi's Japanese-style menu is absolutely my favorite.
lines.style: Sincere, unhurried. The words land with genuine feeling. No rush to move past it. The kind of quiet approval that means something because it's not overstated.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店で、本気で、絶対、素敵な、絶対、お客様、絶対、出会える、絶対、わよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: At Aoi's shop, she really does meet wonderful customers.
lines.style: Tender, almost wistful. Soft consonants, open vowels. The voice carries the sense of watching something good happen. Not loud, but luminous.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、全般、絶対、改革、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感心してるわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious — I really admire how she's transformed the whole shop.
lines.style: Deep respect, carefully articulated. Each word deliberate. The voice carries genuine admiration without gushing. Steady eye-contact tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、丁度、絶対、いい、絶対、温度の、絶対、コーヒー、絶対、提供してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's serving coffee at just the right temperature — that's the kind of detail that matters.
lines.style: Practical observation delivered with understated warmth. Slight smile in the voice. The tone says 'this small thing is actually important,' without needing to explain why.
